list.description: Certificates of the courses you’ve completed. Open one to print it, save it as a PDF or share its verification link.
list.heading: Your certificates

empty.title: No certificate yet
empty.description: Complete a course to earn its certificate. It will appear here.

page.printHint: To keep a copy, print the certificate and choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog.
page.copyFailed: The link couldn’t be copied. You can select it on the certificate instead.

status.issued: Anyone can check it with its verification code or link.
status.revoked: This certificate is no longer valid. Its verification link now shows it as revoked.

dialog.title: Issue this certificate?
dialog.description: The certificate is issued in the learner’s name for this course, with you as the issuer. The learner can then print it from their Certificates page.
dialog.reissueDescription: The certificate becomes valid again with a new verification code and today’s date. The old code stops working.

errors.invalid: This certificate request isn’t valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.conflict: This certificate can’t be issued: the course doesn’t give certificates, or (for a RoboHolic Certified course) the learner hasn’t completed it yet.
errors.forbidden: You can issue a certificate only for a course assigned to a class you teach this learner in.
errors.notFound: This learner isn’t enrolled in the course, or isn’t in one of your classes any more.

dialog.title: Revoke this certificate?
dialog.description: It stops being valid at once: its verification link will show it as revoked. You can issue it again later.
dialog.reasonHint: The learner sees this reason. Up to {max, number} characters.

errors.invalid: This request isn’t valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the teacher who issued this certificate, or a platform administrator, can revoke it.
errors.notFound: This certificate no longer exists, or you can no longer see it.

verify.description: Check that a RoboHolic certificate is genuine and still valid.

valid.title: Valid certificate
valid.description: This certificate was issued through RoboHolic AI and is valid.

revoked.title: Revoked certificate
revoked.description: This certificate was revoked and is no longer valid.

notFound.title: No certificate found
notFound.description: No certificate matches the code {code}. Check the code printed on the certificate: it starts with RH- followed by 10 letters and digits.

verify.privacy: To protect learners’ privacy, this page never shows the name of the person who holds the certificate.
